acceptedAnswer.text: To receive the most accurate Waterfront Property Market Report, it's helpful to provide specific details about your interests. If you're selling, share information about your property's unique features, upgrades, and specific water access. If buying, specify preferred locations (e.g., Las Olas, Midtown/Wynwood), property types, and budget range. This allows Kelby Contreras to narrow down the search parameters and focus on the most relevant comparable properties, ensuring the report directly addresses your needs. The more information you provide, the more tailored and useful the report will be.
acceptedAnswer.description: To get an accurate Waterfront Property Market Report, provide specific details about your property's features if selling, or preferred locations, types, and budget if buying.
